constraints.name: activity_efforts_bike_power_max_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (activity_category <> 'bike'::activity_category OR effort_type <> 'power'::effort_type OR value <= 3000::double precision) NOT VALID

constraints.name: activity_efforts_quality_score_range_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (quality_score IS NULL OR quality_score >= 0::numeric AND quality_score <= 1::numeric)

constraints.name: activity_efforts_run_speed_bounds_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (activity_category <> 'run'::activity_category OR effort_type <> 'speed'::effort_type OR value >= 0.3::double precision AND value <= 13::double precision) NOT VALID

constraints.name: activity_efforts_supported_combination_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (activity_category = 'bike'::activity_category AND effort_type = 'power'::effort_type OR (activity_category = ANY (ARRAY['run'::activity_category, 'swim'::activity_category])) AND effort_type = 'speed'::effort_type) NOT VALID

constraints.name: activity_efforts_swim_speed_bounds_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (activity_category <> 'swim'::activity_category OR effort_type <> 'speed'::effort_type OR value >= 0.1::double precision AND value <= 3::double precision) NOT VALID

constraints.name: activity_efforts_unit_compatibility_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (activity_category = 'bike'::activity_category AND effort_type = 'power'::effort_type AND (unit = ANY (ARRAY['watts'::text, 'W'::text])) OR (activity_category = ANY (ARRAY['run'::activity_category, 'swim'::activity_category])) AND effort_type = 'speed'::effort_type AND (unit = ANY (ARRAY['meters_per_second'::text, 'm/s'::text]))) NOT VALID

constraints.name: activity_efforts_value_finite_positive_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (value > 0::double precision AND (value <> ALL (ARRAY['NaN'::real, 'Infinity'::real, '-Infinity'::real])) OR value = 0::double precision AND activity_id IS NULL AND activity_category = 'bike'::activity_category AND effort_type = 'power'::effort_type AND source = 'manual'::evidence_observation_source AND method = 'profile_update_override'::text AND (provenance ->> 'override_state'::text) = 'cleared'::text) NOT VALID
